checks.message: Low resolution: fine detail may be lost
Shiny reflections: turn off flash or change angle

vasc.india: Infantile haemangiomas and pyogenic granulomas are common.
vasc.dark_skin: Redness is less visible: lesions look dark red, purple or violaceous.
confirm: Blanching on pressure with a glass slide (not in thrombosed lesions)
refer_if: Rapidly growing infant haemangioma near the eye, lip or airway
Purple plaques in an immunocompromised patient (Kaposi sarcoma)
ask: When did it appear, and how fast did it grow?

tell_apart.cue: Melanoma does not blanch and shows a pigment network

tinea.india: India faces an epidemic of chronic, hard-to-treat dermatophytosis, worsened by steroid-antifungal combination creams (tinea incognito).
tinea.dark_skin: The active edge looks dark brown or violaceous rather than red; leaves pigmentation.
confirm: Ring-shaped plaque with an active scaly edge and clearer centre
Check groin, buttocks, feet, nails and family members
refer_if: Extensive or recurrent despite adequate treatment
Scalp in children (kerion needs oral treatment)
first_steps: Keep skin dry; loose cotton clothes; do not share towels
ask: Is the patch spreading outwards with a clearer centre?
Anyone at home with similar patches?
Have you used a steroid or combination cream?

tell_apart.cue: Eczema lacks a sharp active edge; KOH negative
Psoriasis has thick silvery scale on extensor sites
Pityriasis rosea has a herald patch and many oval patches along skin lines
Candida in folds has satellite spots and no central clearing

autoimmune_systemic.india: Includes cutaneous and systemic lupus, scleroderma, dermatomyositis and vasculitis.
autoimmune_systemic.dark_skin: Discoid lupus leaves marked light and dark pigment change and scarring; the malar rash looks less red.
confirm: Ask about joint pain, fever, mouth ulcers, Raynaud's, muscle weakness
ask: Joint pains, fever or mouth ulcers?
Fingers turning white or blue in the cold?

tell_apart.cue: Psoriasis has thick silvery scale and no scarring
Lichen planus is violaceous with Wickham's striae

contact_dermatitis.india: Common triggers include hair dye (PPD), cement, rubber footwear, nickel jewellery, bindi adhesive, cosmetics, and airborne parthenium weed.
contact_dermatitis.dark_skin: Less red; more dark pigmentation and thickening in chronic cases.
confirm: The shape matches the contact (strap, slipper, hairline, watch)
refer_if: Widespread rash or facial and eyelid swelling
Not improving after avoiding the trigger
first_steps: Emollient; short topical steroid course by clinician
ask: New hair dye, cosmetic, footwear or jewellery?
Does it improve on holidays or away from work?
Does it match where something touches the skin?

tell_apart.cue: Atopic eczema has a personal/family history of atopy and typical flexural sites
Tinea has an active scaly edge; do a KOH test before any steroid

pemphigus.india: Pemphigus vulgaris is relatively more common in India; bullous pemphigoid affects the elderly.
confirm: Flaccid blisters and erosions, mouth erosions (pemphigus); tense blisters in the elderly (pemphigoid)
refer_if: Urgent if erosions are extensive, the patient cannot eat, or there is infection
first_steps: Do not start steroids before the diagnosis is confirmed
ask: Blisters that break easily, or tense blisters?

tell_apart.cue: SJS/TEN follows a new drug with fever and target lesions
Bullous impetigo has honey crusts, often in children
